artifacts.synopsis: Complainant alleged that Pacific Presbytery erred in not opposing the ordination of Lee Irons as a Ruling Elder at New Life Burbank, given that Pacific Presbytery had previously denied Irons's application as a Teaching Elder candidate; the SJC denied the complaint, holding that each court retains discretion to evaluate candidates for ordination within its jurisdiction and that Presbytery's denial for Teaching Elder did not preclude a Session's ordination of the same man as Ruling Elder.
